name: Chronicles from the Abyss
source:
Chronicles from the Abyss is a collection of 4 twisted Horror & Thriller stories that will play on the darkest corners of your mind, & every choice drips with dread. Twisted plots, haunting art, and chilling secrets await. Ready to uncover what lurks beneath?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3698640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《深渊编年史》收录了4个扭曲的恐怖和惊悚故事，它们将在你心灵最黑暗的角落上演，每一个选择都充满恐惧。扭曲的情节、令人难忘的艺术和令人毛骨悚然的秘密等待着你。准备好揭开隐藏的秘密了吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3698640/]Steam[/url]]
